column1: # Sim-bus golden vectors (BUS-04). Read by internal/bus/codec_test.go and tests/cpp/test_protocol.cpp.
# Columns separated by one TAB: name, kind (valid|invalid|encode), line, expect. Lines starting with # are comments.
# line: the wire line WITHOUT its trailing newline. %HH is a byte escape (so a TSV can carry TAB, NUL, UTF-8); a literal percent is %25.
# valid:   expect is the decoded tuple in line order: key=s:<string> | key=n:<float32 literal> | key=i:<int64>, separated by ;
#          n fields compare as float32 (ParseFloat(x,32) / strtof), never as text. Test strings contain no ; or TAB.
# invalid: expect is the error class: empty too_long not_object nested bad_key bad_value bad_escape bad_char dup_key missing_k bad_k bad_number trailing
# encode:  both encoders must produce `line` byte for byte (plus newline) from the tuple.
# --- valid: numbers (values are compared as float32, not as text)
# --- valid: Phase 2 frames (rgb chan with n and seg, px out, button in, env in)
# --- encode: pinned set where Go FormatFloat('g',-1,32) and C++ to_chars(float) agree
